name: toolbelt
description: Talha's own Claude Code plugins: test an idea (seed), build it right (forge), film it (reel).

plugins.name: seed
plugins.description: Generate ideas and test them on a simulated crowd; outputs IDEA-BRIEF.md and a visual IDEA-BOARD.html.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Project lifecycle from start to launch: router for vague requests, evidence-based gates, agents, loops, security baseline, anti-slop UI lane.

plugins.name: reel
plugins.description: Make a demo film of any live product from one command: story, playable board, 2x captures, AI voice, licensed music, QA, publish kit.

plugins.name: eli5
plugins.description: Explain any topic like I'm five with a self-contained HTML picture explainer.
